messages.subject: Recommendations for gpcount information
parts:
Can anyone recommend manuscripts that use a number of site level covariates (~5 or more) to model abundance using gpcount?

I've got about 90 sites, 4 primary occasions, 2 secondary occasions, and my parameter of greatest interest is estimated abundance per site.  

Coding tutorials would be especially helpful as well.

Apologies if this has been covered before, but I've not been able to locate the information i need and the clock is ticking!

Thank you ahead of time,

Scott B.
